draft.note: The draft's own provenance: the pass that wrote it, the rows it read and the tickets that replace it attribute by attribute under this id.

function.note: The 1911 sheet reads '3-storey brick building lettered GARAGE, auto repairing on the second floor, wood-working and painting on the third, an office on the first, two rows of iron columns each floor'. In 1904 this was Bane Brothers' livery and boarding stables, which the Blue Book for that year advertises at 2125, 2127 and 2129 Indiana Avenue; the same address was a horse livery until 1910 and the West Motor Livery Co.'s garage by 1911, so the sheet's garage is read as the livery's stable kept in use (T-3013). Carried to 1904 on the T-3009 census ruling (present_as_mapped).
